items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

ctx.x: Oh, they got some wonderful people in this business.

I know so well. Steal everything they get a hold of. I know. Steal everything they get a hold of. I know. They had it under the table. Yeah, they just steal all my stuff. I wish we could do that. And if I know, see, by my back with 200 orange, I couldn't see, you know, looking like that all the time. And Joe, I see them. Joe, I see them. Joe, I see them. He said, business, I'm probably stealing. So I said, look on the table. I got up. I went to them. I went to them. Yeah, you're going to tell them about that.…
I will. Maybe we ought to get a little, uh, earnest on here too. Let's give it, let's give him a chance. Yeah, go ahead.
